meaning:
Hazar-enan = "village of fountains"
a city on the northeast border of Canaan; same as cha.tsar e.non (חֲצַר עֵינָן "Hazar-enan" H2703)
Also named: cha.tsar e.non (חֲצַר עֵינָן "Hazar-enan" H2703)

renderings.kjv: of it shall be at Hazarenan

elsewhere.note: Then the border shall go to Ziphron, and it shall end at Hazar Enan. This shall be your north border.
“Now these are the names of the tribes: From the north end, beside the way of Hethlon to the entrance of Hamath, Hazar Enan at the border of Damascus…
